<thought>To find the appropriate SN2 retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a halide (e.g., C‑Cl) and form a carbon‑nitrogen bond, which corresponds to functional groups broken = halide and functional groups formed = amine. This should retrieve the template(s) needed to generate the precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
